subject: FDA flags hidden drug ingredients in products sold for sleep, skin, and bodybuilding
script: From Agewell Brief: FDA flags hidden drug ingredients in products sold for sleep, skin, and bodybuilding. The agency's health-fraud list now includes pre-workout products, alongside earlier alerts for supplements marketed for sleep, skin, pain, and bodybuilding. FDA's list flags products with undeclared drug ingredients. Recent additions: PRE-FORMANCE BLACK and RAPTURE Preworkout. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
